findings.title: Out-of-scope sport pages are published in other desk trees
findings.detail: 46 HTML files under desk directories publish aussie-rules.html or esports.html, neither of which is in the 15-sport scope. Example: sports/esports.html, atlas/sports/esports.html, beacon/sports/esports.html.
findings.severity_note: Does not affect /summit/, which publishes only the 15 requested sports.

findings.title: Other layers’ prediction data contains forbidden words
findings.detail: data/daily-picks/predictions.json, data/portal/predictions.json and data/update/predictions.json contain reader-facing occurrences of model or verified. /summit/ predictions exclude those words.
findings.severity_note: Historical layers are preserved; /summit/ is audited separately.

findings.title: Unresolved merge-conflict markers remain in COORDINATION.md
findings.detail: COORDINATION.md carries six closing conflict markers (lines 3216, 3307, 3437, 3549, 3609, 3628). They are plain text and do not break builds, but they make the shared board harder to read.
findings.severity_note: Left for the owning sessions; not edited by /summit/.

findings.title: Root dashboard points to a stale snapshot
findings.detail: The root dashboard still advertises a 2026-10-22 snapshot and its primary call to action opens /monitor/, which reports no high-confidence picks. /summit/ is a separate current desk and is not yet linked from root navigation.
findings.evidence: index.html and /monitor/ pages in the repository
findings.severity_note: Root integration is deferred to the integration session.

findings.title: 51 HTML files in other layers have table rows without external official links
findings.detail: Verification requires every sourced data row to link to an official site. 51 published HTML files have table rows with no external http(s) link in other desk trees.
findings.severity_note: /summit/ flags unverified rows instead of hiding them.
